gallery.description:
Three water towers within the w:Cuyuna Iron Range Municipally-Owned Elevated Metal Water Tanks in northern Minnesota.  These water tanks are listed on the National Register of Historic Places.  The tanks are from Deerwood, Minnesota, Crosby, Minnesota, and Ironton, Minnesota.
